name: forsvn-preview
description: Optional review-surface preview for FORSVN artifacts. Renders a standard Markdown artifact into a themed HTML preview (stack -> element: meta=air, marketing=water, product=fire, research=earth) and serves a CSRF-protected localhost decision-capture surface that writes the decision_state back into the artifact's frontmatter. Skills emit plain Markdown; install this plugin to preview, comment, approve, deny, or request changes. The /forsvn-preview:review command lets an agent list pending artifacts and serve one for a human decision.
